Chapter 294: Chapter 5: Choice, Battlefield C24763 (Please Subscribe)

Time flowed slowly.

The strange power deep within Lin Yuan’s bloodline became increasingly apparent.

“Could this awakened Physical Body Divine Ability… be geared towards combat and fighting?”

Physical Body Divine Abilities also come in different types.

Some are adept at defense,

some at preserving life,

...

and some at attacking…

It all depends on which strange power deep in the bloodline is activated.

Hum!!

Just as Lin Yuan was feeling it attentively,

a complete strange power ‘peeled off’ from deep within his blood vessels.

Immediately afterward,

information about this strange power flooded into Lin Yuan’s mind.

“Physical Body Divine Ability—Mountain Moving?”

Lin Yuan naturally understood everything about this ‘Mountain Moving’ Divine Ability.

The Divine Ability ‘Mountain Moving’ does not literally mean moving mountains; it’s more of a symbol or description.

“I didn’t expect the awakened Physical Body Divine Ability to be tied to the Rule of Power,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The ‘Mountain Moving’ Divine Ability is a pure ‘Power Divine Skill’, related to the Rule of Power.

Compared to other cosmic rules, the Rule of Power is undoubtedly the most common, after all, as long as there are beings, they possess power.

Therefore,

it’s not difficult to get started on the Rule of Power.

In the last Seven Star Cave trial, there was a Red Pattern named Brutal Force who had entered the Rule of Power at Fourth Rank.

Of course, ‘not difficult’ here is relative to those true genius Evolvers.

For the average Evolver, to perceive the Rule of Power to the threshold of entry, they would need at least to be at Fifth Rank or even Sixth Rank.

Otherwise, Brutal Force would not have been designated by the Chikun Star Lord as a Red Pattern Examiner.

“The Rule of Power, easy to start with, with a high ceiling, if one comprehends deep into the Rule of Power, every move can shatter everything with power—a very pure path…” Lin Yuan mused.

The nine Evolution Towers of the Cosmic Alliance of Human Civilizations symbolize the indisputable peak of the evolution field.

One of those towers is the Tower of Power, and the Supreme Being residing in that Evolution Tower follows the path of the Rule of Power.

“Hm?”

Lin Yuan sensed the strange power related to the ‘Mountain Moving’ Power Divine Skill forming secret patterns within his flesh, resembling a magic web.

These secret patterns subtly resonated with the external Rule of Power. Lin Yuan felt that with any casual strike, he could carry a trace of the Rule of Power, and his attacks would become several to ten times more powerful in terms of force.

“These…”

Lin Yuan carefully observed the secret patterns within his flesh.

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding allows you to observe the essential secret patterns of the Rule of Power, deepening your understanding of the Rule of Power…..]

…

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding allows you to observe the essential secret patterns of the Rule of Power, deepening your understanding of the Rule of Power…..]

…

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding allows you to observe the essential secret patterns of the Rule of Power, deepening your understanding of the Rule of Power…..]

…

Only a short while had passed.

Lin Yuan came to his senses.

“Have I actually made an entry into the Rule of Power?”

Lin Yuan was startled. Previously, he had not delved into the Rule of Power.

Even with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, how vast are the great ways of the world? One would certainly focus most of their energy on the laws and great ways they wish to comprehend, such as Taiyin Taiyang Taiji or space, etc.

The Dao of Taiji governs thousands of other daos with one, but here, it does not mean fully comprehending them all; rather, it uses the Dao of Taiji to command the other thousands of daos.

It is like using a knife, you can wield it, but you have no understanding of the knife’s construction and essence.

As for the Rule of Power, even though entering it is not difficult, according to Lin Yuan’s estimates, if he were to fully focus on this path, it would still take him more than ten days.

Now it took just a short while?

“Is it because of these secret patterns?”

“These secret patterns are the essence of the Power Divine Skill ‘Mountain Moving’.”

“By comprehending these secret patterns, am I comprehending a deeper layer of the Rule of Power?”

Lin Yuan appeared thoughtful.

“I didn’t expect this Physical Body Divine Ability to have such a use,” Lin Yuan said with a smile on his face.

The Divine Skill ‘Mountain Moving’ could already enhance Lin Yuan’s frontal combat ability, and now it could also make understanding the Rule of Power easier for him.

“It’s just the Blood Rebirth…”

Lin Yuan carefully felt the ‘Blood Rebirth’ technique imprint.

In the Immortal Tao World, Lin Yuan, with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, fully comprehended the ‘Blood Rebirth’ without feeling that this divine skill resonated with any particular rule.

“Perhaps Divine Skills vary from one another…”

Lin Yuan did not linger on this. Blood Rebirth or Mountain Moving, they were all freely given methods.

…

In the Chikun Star Realm Virtual World,

in the Central Plaza Area,

“The Martial Path Evolutionary Path does not require pre-existing conditions, like an innately powerful physique, innately robust spirit, or a special constitution, etc…

“Anyone can practice it, but whether one can enter or step into the Innate Realm—depends on the individual…”

A burly man looked towards the towering evolution leaderboard in the distance and said in a low voice to several young Evolvers beside him.

Martial Arts Evolutionaries at least offer a chance for people to try, while other Evolution Paths might outright dismiss you if you don’t meet certain conditions.

If you don’t have the pre-requisite, you won’t even be able to step through the door.

“Mr. Chen, I’m trying to break through to the Innate Chapter, but what exactly is ‘Innate Qi’ mentioned in there?” a young man couldn’t help but ask.

The First Tier Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path begins with the Innate Realm.

As for the Acquired Realm, it is a pre-entry level state; Martial Arts Evolutionaries who enter this realm are equivalent to other pre-entry Evolvers.

“Innate Qi…”

The burly man fell silent for a moment. He wasn’t an Evolver on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path; how would he know what Innate Qi was?
